_comment: WINDOWS FRESH-USER M5.1: the single source of truth for the two EXTERNAL, third-party archives windows-fresh-user CI downloads and executes (the KAI compiler ZIP and VSIX are same-commit build artifacts from this same workflow and are deliberately NOT pinned here - see M5.1's report). Both entries below were verified this round: winlibs's sha256 matches the .sha256 file WinLibs itself publishes alongside the release asset, and vscode's sha256 matches the x-sha256 response header Microsoft's own download endpoint returns for this exact version. scripts/verify-pinned-download.ps1 reads this file and refuses to let CI extract/execute either archive unless its downloaded bytes hash to exactly the value recorded here.
